name: Ruby
graha_quality: Natural benefic for Leo lagna; karaka for soul, authority, and government. Functional malefic for Libra, Capricorn, and Aquarius lagna.
issues_addressed: Career stagnation and lack of leadership
Strained relationship with father or authority figures
benefits: Enhances confidence, authority and leadership
Improves career prospects and recognition
Strengthens the immune system and vitality
Brings clarity of thought and willpower
wearing_nakshatra: Uttara Phalguni, Uttara Ashadha, or Kritika
activation_mantra: Om Hraam Hreem Hraum Sah Suryaya Namah
quality_note: Use untreated, eye-clean, natural ruby — not heated or glass-filled
upratna_note: Upratna gives 40-60% effect at lower cost
caution: Avoid if Saturn, Venus or Rahu are strong lords in your chart. Those with Libra, Taurus, Capricorn or Aquarius lagna should generally avoid ruby.

name: Pearl
graha_quality: Natural benefic; karaka for mind, emotions, and mother. Best for Cancer lagna. Functional malefic for Capricorn and Aquarius lagna.
issues_addressed: Lack of mental peace and concentration
benefits: Calms the mind and stabilizes emotions
Improves sleep quality and mental peace
Strengthens intuition and emotional intelligence
Enhances beauty and personal charm
activation_mantra: Om Shraam Shreem Shraum Sah Chandraya Namah
quality_note: Use natural, lustrous pearl with good orient — not cultured or artificial
upratna_note: Moonstone is widely available and gives calming lunar energy at lower cost
caution: Avoid during Rahu-Moon conjunction or if Moon is severely afflicted by Saturn without remedial measures.

name: Red Coral
graha_quality: Natural malefic; karaka for courage, siblings, and property. Yogakaraka for Cancer and Leo lagna. Functional benefic for Aries and Scorpio lagna.
issues_addressed: Mangal Dosha causing marital delays or conflict
Lack of physical energy and stamina
benefits: Boosts physical energy, courage and vitality
Helps overcome Mangal Dosha effects
Improves blood circulation and hemoglobin
Aids in property matters and legal disputes
wearing_time: 1 hour after sunrise, during Mangal Hora
activation_mantra: Om Kraam Kreem Kraum Sah Bhaumaya Namah
quality_note: Use natural, Italian or Japanese red coral — avoid dyed or synthetic
upratna_note: Carnelian provides Mars energy at a fraction of the cost
caution: Avoid if Mars is a functional malefic for your lagna (Gemini, Virgo, Libra). Can increase aggression if Mars is already strong.

name: Emerald
graha_quality: Natural benefic; karaka for intellect, communication, and commerce. Best for Gemini and Virgo lagna. Adapts qualities of associated planets.
benefits: Sharpens intellect and analytical abilities
Enhances communication and public speaking
Supports business acumen and financial wisdom
Calms the nervous system and reduces anxiety
wearing_time: 2 hours after sunrise, during Budh Hora
activation_mantra: Om Braam Breem Braum Sah Budhaya Namah
quality_note: Use natural, untreated emerald with good transparency — minor inclusions (jardine) are acceptable and natural
upratna_note: Green Tourmaline offers similar Mercury benefits at 30-50% effectiveness
caution: Avoid if Mercury is combust or heavily afflicted by Mars in your chart without proper analysis.

name: Yellow Sapphire
graha_quality: Greatest natural benefic; karaka for wisdom, dharma, children, and fortune. Beneficial for most lagnas. Especially powerful for Sagittarius, Pisces, Aries, Cancer, and Leo lagna.
issues_addressed: Delayed marriage or difficulties in finding a suitable partner
Financial instability and lack of prosperity
Lack of spiritual growth and wisdom
Difficulties in higher education or teaching career
benefits: Attracts wealth, prosperity and good fortune
Enhances wisdom, knowledge and spiritual growth
Supports marital harmony and finding a good partner
Blesses with children and academic success
activation_mantra: Om Graam Greem Graum Sah Gurave Namah
quality_note: Use natural, untreated Ceylon yellow sapphire with good brilliance and even color
upratna_note: Citrine is affordable and widely available; gives 30-40% of Pukhraj's effects
caution: Generally safe for most lagnas. Avoid only if Jupiter is a strong functional malefic (rare). Taurus and Libra lagna should be cautious.

name: Diamond
graha_quality: Natural benefic; karaka for love, marriage, luxury, arts, and beauty. Best for Taurus and Libra lagna. Also benefits Capricorn and Aquarius lagna.
issues_addressed: Marital problems and lack of romantic fulfillment
Lack of artistic talent or creative blocks
Diminished beauty, charm, or social standing
benefits: Enhances love, romance and marital harmony
Attracts luxury, wealth and material comforts
Boosts creativity and artistic abilities
Improves reproductive health and vitality
wearing_finger: Middle finger or ring finger of right hand
wearing_nakshatra: Bharani, Purva Phalguni, or Purva Ashadha
activation_mantra: Om Draam Dreem Draum Sah Shukraya Namah
quality_note: Use natural, untreated diamond with good brilliance (VS clarity or better). Avoid cloudy, chipped, or black-spotted diamonds.
upratna_note: White Sapphire is the best substitute and gives 50-60% of Diamond's effects
caution: Avoid if Sun, Moon or Mars are the primary benefics in your chart. Those with Aries, Scorpio, Leo or Cancer lagna should generally avoid Diamond. This is a powerful stone — astrologer consultation strongly recommended.
price_range_inr: ₹15,000 – ₹10,00,000+ depending on carat, cut, clarity, and color

name: Blue Sapphire
graha_quality: Natural malefic; karaka for longevity, karma, discipline, and justice. Yogakaraka for Taurus and Libra lagna. Functional benefic for Capricorn and Aquarius lagna.
issues_addressed: Chronic delays in career and life progress
Sade Sati or Shani Dhaiya period afflictions
Chronic health issues especially joint and bone problems
benefits: Accelerates career progress and removes obstacles
Protects during Sade Sati and Saturn transits
Brings discipline, focus and determination
Improves chronic health conditions and longevity
activation_mantra: Om Praam Preem Praum Sah Shanaischaraya Namah
quality_note: MUST trial-wear for 3 days before permanent wearing. Use untreated, eye-clean blue sapphire with even color.
upratna_note: Amethyst is safe, affordable, and widely used as a Saturn substitute
caution: MOST POWERFUL AND DANGEROUS of all navaratnas. Can cause severe negative effects if Saturn is not favorable. MUST consult an experienced Jyotish acharya before wearing. Trial period of 3 days is mandatory — observe dreams and events closely.

name: Hessonite Garnet
graha_quality: Shadow planet (Chhaya Graha); amplifies the house it sits in. Karaka for foreign connections, sudden events, and material obsessions. Acts like Saturn.
issues_addressed: Sudden financial losses or unexpected setbacks
Problems in foreign travels or immigration
benefits: Neutralizes negative Rahu effects
Brings clarity during confusion and chaos
Supports success in foreign countries
Aids in overcoming addictions and obsessions
wearing_time: After sunset, during Rahu Kaal if beneficial
activation_mantra: Om Bhraam Bhreem Bhraum Sah Rahave Namah
quality_note: Use natural, untreated Hessonite with honey-like color and good transparency
upratna_note: Orange Zircon provides mild Rahu pacification at lower cost
caution: Wear only during Rahu Mahadasha or when Rahu is functionally benefic for your lagna. Can amplify obsessive tendencies if Rahu is already strong.

name: Cat's Eye
graha_quality: Shadow planet (Chhaya Graha); karaka for moksha, spirituality, and detachment. Acts like Mars. Gives sudden and unexpected results.
issues_addressed: Unexplained health issues and mysterious ailments
Spiritual blocks and lack of progress in sadhana
Sudden financial losses from unknown causes
Past-life karmic debts causing present difficulties
benefits: Accelerates spiritual growth and moksha path
Protects from hidden enemies and evil eye
Resolves mysterious and chronic health issues
Brings intuitive wisdom and psychic abilities
wearing_finger: Ring finger or middle finger of right hand
activation_mantra: Om Sraam Sreem Sraum Sah Ketave Namah
quality_note: Use natural Chrysoberyl Cat's Eye with sharp chatoyancy (cat's eye effect). The band of light should be clearly visible.
upratna_note: Tiger's Eye is widely available and gives gentle Ketu pacification
caution: Highly specific stone — wear ONLY during Ketu Mahadasha or when Ketu is functionally benefic. Can cause extreme detachment and disinterest in material life if worn incorrectly.
